public.text: The section recommends designing data structures first. Designing structures before analysing workflows, decisions, actors, and information needs may produce technically coherent but operationally unsuitable models.
public.suggestedRevision: Use a sequence beginning with use cases, actors, workflows, decisions, and information requirements, followed by logical modelling, terminology binding, implementation profiling, and validation.
